header_policy: .h and .inc require ownership by a trustworthy C compile-command dependency closure; otherwise ambiguous
decision_reason: All twenty-two bounded C outcomes now reach value-tested final artifacts. Support remains limited to the documented Clang 21+, C17, trustworthy compile-command, Make/native-check, accepted-evidence, and human-authority boundaries.

native_check: complete current C17 compile database plus Clang 21 and Make native test/smoke
copied adapter artifacts, exact roles, lifecycle recovery, and source preservation
skills.limitation: Objective compile-database and Make project facts only; no framework, layout-health, arbitrary build-system, macro-variant, C++, or Objective-C claim.

native_check: Clang raw comment tokens over a current complete C17 compile-command snapshot
copied resolved/orphan decision artifacts, lifecycle recovery, native gates, and preservation
skills.limitation: Registry-token syntax in real comments only; applicability, macro expansion, inactive branches, symbol meaning, runtime behavior, and frameworks remain unresolved.

native_check: compiler-owned direct declaration and definition spelling plus exact hashes
copied explanation, targets, annotations, unresolved sidecars, native gates, and preservation
skills.limitation: Direct static and lexical declarations only; macro-expanded identity, callers, behavior, types, ABI, arbitrary variants, C++, and Objective-C remain unresolved.

native_check: accepted C semantic fact pack and candidate-hash-bound implicit-state evidence
copied exact-field proposal, caller inventory, refusal lifecycle, and source preservation
skills.limitation: Proposal-only for one reviewed const-char-pointer field; no closed-domain, ABI/layout, wire/storage, external-consumer, macro-variant, or mutation authority is implied.

native_check: make clean test CC=clang and Clang C17 syntax/raw-token checks
nine focused cases including copied closure, terminal-state replacement, and source preservation
skills.limitation: Lexical raw-token findings only; macro expansion, inactive branches, comment-to-symbol meaning, C++, Objective-C, and framework conventions remain outside the claim.

native_check: Clang AST direct-body branch facts over the exact C17 compile-command snapshot
copied score-8 advisory outcome, macro/callee decoys, native gates, lifecycle, and preservation
skills.limitation: Frozen direct-body syntactic score only; macros, runtime cost/control flow, performance, behavior, arbitrary build variants, and refactor safety remain unresolved.

native_check: current compiler-owned C17 source snapshot plus strict glossary spelling
copied one-hit and clean final artifacts, exact hashes, exclusions, native gates, and preservation
skills.limitation: Strict authored-text evidence only; comments and strings may be review noise, and preprocessor spelling, symbol identity, rename completeness, and frameworks remain unresolved.

native_check: Clang 21 AST direct references for one private static definition under a complete C17 snapshot
copied review-required outcome, clean case, native smoke, lifecycle recovery, and preservation
skills.limitation: certain_delete is always zero; address-taking, function pointers, callbacks, registration, macros, variants, external reachability, dynamic loading, and safe deletion remain unresolved.

native_check: compiler-owned direct function-body spelling and exact normalized hashes
copied one-clone-pair triage, changed-body decoy, native gates, lifecycle, and preservation
skills.limitation: Exact direct-body spelling is an advisory clone lead only; macros, semantic or behavioral equivalence, consolidation authority, and arbitrary variants remain unresolved.

native_check: complete compiler-owned translation-unit inventory plus direct-sibling filename clustering
copied threshold-three finding and threshold-four clean outcome, native gates, lifecycle, and preservation
skills.limitation: Direct-sibling filename evidence only; no namespace, ownership, layout-health, include/build impact, framework convention, or safe-move claim.

native_check: Clang-resolved const-char-pointer field and three direct literal assignments
candidate-hash-bound human review, copied artifacts, native smoke, lifecycle recovery, and preservation
skills.limitation: enum_review_only evidence does not prove a closed domain; aliasing, callbacks, external mutation, TLS, macros, variants, wire/storage, and automatic migration remain unresolved.

native_check: Clang-resolved direct compound literals plus bounded Git trajectory
candidate-hash-bound fixed-vocabulary verdict, copied manifest, native smoke, lifecycle recovery, and preservation
skills.limitation: One direct designated-initializer omission shape only; macro-expanded literals, aliases, wrappers, external callers, incomplete history, arbitrary variants, and automatic fixes remain unresolved.

native_check: Clang named-function syntax clusters over the exact current C17 snapshot
candidate-hash-bound explicit scout verdict, copied final findings, native gates, lifecycle, and preservation
skills.limitation: Function-name clusters only nominate candidates; human domain judgment is mandatory, and macro meaning, runtime responsibility, safe decomposition, and frameworks remain unresolved.

native_check: Clang-resolved direct record return shapes and distinct direct callers
copied static review lead, clean/deferred boundaries, native smoke, lifecycle recovery, and preservation
skills.limitation: Static review lead only; aliasing, undefined behavior, side effects, function pointers, external behavior, arbitrary variants, behavioral equivalence, and consolidation safety remain unresolved.

native_check: Clang direct-call spelling plus configured syntactic if enclosure
copied two-site/one-gap 50-percent census, decoys, native gates, lifecycle, and preservation
skills.limitation: Only direct call spelling and one frozen enclosed_by-if condition are supported; callee identity, aliases, function pointers, runtime control flow, general policy, and frameworks remain unresolved.

native_check: make clean compile-db CC=clang plus Clang/clangd 21 C17 attribution
twelve focused cases including copied closure, native test/smoke, lifecycle recovery, and preservation
skills.limitation: Complete only for the exact current C17 compile-command snapshot; macro and inactive-branch facts, function-pointer targets, ABI/layout, arbitrary variants, C++, Objective-C, and framework semantics remain outside the claim.

native_check: content-addressed preview approval for one authored C17 source file and exact include/Make edits
copied dry-run/apply/check, regenerated compile database, native smoke, exact after-tree, refusal, and rollback
skills.limitation: One .c file move inside one Clang/C17/Make project only; no directory/public-header/symbol move, arbitrary build system, inactive macro variant, ABI guarantee, or external-consumer completeness.

native_check: accepted enum proposal with all four human gates and current migrated-source hashes
staged C17 _Static_assert/_Generic guard passes migrated source and fails the exact buildable type reversion
skills.limitation: Stages but never installs one exact-field type guard; enumerator values, assignments, aliases, conversion functions, runtime behavior, other fields, and general lint coverage remain unresolved.

native_check: accepted explicit-scout omnibus evidence plus current complete C map and exact source/Make census
read-only ready/cohesive-defer artifacts and independently applied disposable after-tree native verification
skills.limitation: Proposal-only for one accepted selected-configuration seam; function pointers, aliases, runtime reachability, alternate variants, external consumers, ABI/layout, linkage, undefined behavior, and mutation remain unresolved.

native_check: accepted three-member prefix cluster, explicit project convention, current complete C map, and exact impact census
read-only ready/keep-flat/no-convention outcomes and independently applied disposable after-tree native verification
skills.limitation: One reviewed direct-sibling C cluster plan only; filename grouping proves no ownership, and alternate variants, external consumers, public compatibility, ABI, automatic mutation, and frameworks remain unresolved.

native_check: Clang-observed old/new typedef declarations and direct selected-source references
copied half-applied and candidate-complete assessments, native smoke, lifecycle recovery, and preservation
skills.limitation: Assess-only selected-configuration evidence; macros, strings, inactive variants, external consumers, ABI compatibility, arbitrary build variants, codemod safety, and mutation remain unresolved.

native_check: current accepted C semantic-duplication lead plus exact definition/caller citations and human-selected shape
copied three-artifact ready/keep-separate/refusal lifecycle, source preservation, Make test, and exact smoke
skills.limitation: Read-only proposal only; direct-call static evidence is not behavioral equivalence, and ABI/export drift, function pointers, external consumers, variants, side effects, undefined behavior, survivor choice, and mutation remain human-owned.
